Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Banff hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 15 Banff hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 13 and trivago DEALS at 2. These are the Banff rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 15 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 13 and trivago DEALS at 2 (a tie counts for each site). Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Banff hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($13 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Bow View Lodge to 11% at Banff Rocky Mountain Resort. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
